content.stem: 在离岸金融中心（OFC）设立的商业实体会给洗钱活动带来独特风险，因为它们通常：

options.A: 个人或实体之间存在非正式的业务安排
options.B: 位于不受美国法律约束的地区
options.C: 包括信托、投资基金和保险公司
options.D: 设立这些商业实体时，组织披露和记录保存要求相对宽松

content.stem_en: Business entities established in offshore financial centers (OFCs) pose unique risks for money laundering because they often:

options_en.A: Have informal business arrangements between persons or entities
options_en.B: Are located in geographies that are not accountable to U.S. laws
options_en.C: Include trusts, investment funds, and insurance companies
options_en.D: Have limited organizational disclosure and recordkeeping requirements for establishing these business entities
